decisions.reason: As a core bread line with its own page and little sign of failure, management would likely continue it because it fits the established bakery business and there is no strong trigger to reverse the 2023 launch.
This stollen is a publicly emphasized flagship and has won a gold medal, so sunk investment, reputational commitment, and positive external validation make withdrawal very unlikely.

The product is close to the firm's bread tradition and visible enough to justify persistence, although assortment overlap with other rye breads makes it somewhat easier to prune than the flagship items.

Management would still tend to keep this recently launched rye variant because it builds on existing capabilities, but its more niche positioning and overlap within the bread range raise the chance of later rationalization.

Even though it is seasonal and sits beside a stronger stollen flagship, it remains close to the firm's confectionery core and recent launch commitments encourage continuation for at least another cycle.

The firm presented this ancient grain bread as its newest 'Meisterstück', and that public framing plus fit with artisanal baking makes management likely to persist rather than admit the launch was premature.
